comprehensive_coverage.rationale: Packet includes 15 vertical bar graph tasks, 8 horizontal bar graph tasks, and 2 mixed-orientation samples, providing robust coverage of both orientations. Data domains span animals, sports, subjects, grades, months, flowers, and activities. Scale increments vary between 5, 10, and 20. Item count and variety support reliable measurement of the bar graph component of competency.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: Twenty-five samples provide sufficient instances for robust assessment. Highest data values span from 35 to 95, matching Grade 3 computational expectations. Category counts of 3, 4, and 6 items allow learners to track moderate data sets without overwhelming cognitive load typical for nine-year-olds working with whole numbers.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Samples demonstrate variation in scale increments (5, 10, 20 per axis), graph orientation (horizontal and vertical), data domain (animals, months, subjects, grades, sports, flowers), category count (3, 4, 6 items), and framing language (create versus complete). Two samples include thematic emoji elements without interfering with task clarity. Interactive format remains consistent, permitting focus on data representation.
